mprDetailingTransfer.Description: Transferring view detailing (dimensions, tags, spot elevations, text) to views with similar geometry in the current or another open project
mprDetailingTransfer.h5: There are no views with annotations in the current project
mprDetailingTransfer.h8: Number of annotations in the view
mprDetailingTransfer.h17: The way the source and target models are aligned. Required when the detailing is transferred to another document in which the model is offset relative to the source one. When aligning by base points, after clicking "Transfer" specify a point in the source view and then the corresponding point in the target view
mprDetailingTransfer.h18: Specify a base point in the source view
mprDetailingTransfer.h19: Specify a base point in the target view
mprDetailingTransfer.h20: The target document is not saved. Save the document to specify a base point in its view
